verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms official install paths via Docker and Kubernetes (kubectl/kustomize/helm) plus pip/uv, but there's no mention of a Docker Compose-specific guide, no VPS-targeted guide, and no Raspberry Pi guide anywhere in the pack. Community feedback also notes frustration with large Docker image sizes, suggesting lightweight/edge deployment isn't well-supported. Missing for 10: dedicated Docker Compose guide, small-VPS deployment guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM deployment guide, and independent corroboration that these guides are maintained.
